result: I fixed the pagination bug in `PostController.index` (`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`). The controller was calling `paginate({ page: page + 1, ... })`, which skipped one page, so `/posts` started at the 11th newest post. It now passes the requested page straight through. The pager, links and "from–to of total" numbers all come from the same paginator result, so they now match the page shown. Newest-first order, 10 per page and search are unchanged. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (2 tests). I didn't add a test for the list or check `/posts` over HTTP.
